content:
Set the probability equal to \(\frac12\):

\[
\frac{2k(n-k)}{n(n-1)}=\frac12
\]

so

\[
4k(n-k)=n(n-1).
\]

Solving for \(k\):

\[
4k^2-4nk+(n^2-n)=0
\]

\[
k=\frac{n\pm \sqrt{n}}{2}.
\]

Thus \(n\) must be a perfect square. The only perfect square between \(2000\) and \(2100\) is

\[
2025=45^2.
\]

\[
\boxed{2025}
\]
